ov: العقل والعاطفة (بالإنجليزية: Sense and Sensibility) هو فيلم درامي تاريخي رومانسي بريطاني أمريكي صدر عام 2026، من إخراج جورجيا أوكلي وسيناريو ديانا ريد، مقتبس من رواية العقل والعاطفة التي نشرتها جاين أوستن عام 1811. يشارك في بطولته ديزي إدغار جونز، وإيسمي كريد مايلز، وكاترينا بالف، وفرانك ديلان، وهربرت نوردروم، وجورج ماكاي، وفيونا شو. صدر الفيلم في المملكة المتحدة في 25 سبتمبر 2026، وفي الولايات المتحدة في 16 أكتوبر من العام نفسه، وتلقى مراجعات إيجابية عمومًا من النقاد.
plotEn:
The Dashwood sisters – Elinor, Marianne and Margaret – and their mother face potential poverty when, on Mr Dashwood's death, his estate passes to the sisters' half-brother John and his snobbish wife, Fanny. Fanny persuades John to withhold the financial assistance his father had asked him to provide, and the couple take possession of the estate, disrupting the sisters' lives. Fanny's brother, Edward Ferrars, visits and forms a close bond with Elinor, much to Fanny's dismay. Mrs Jennings, a distant relative of the Dashwoods, offers them a Devonshire cottage owned by her son-in-law, Sir John Middleton, at a reduced rent. Mrs Dashwood accepts. Elinor hopes that Edward will propose, though he merely promises to visit.
In Devonshire, Marianne initially finds Colonel Brandon, a family friend of Sir John, unappealing. Brandon, however, develops feelings for Marianne. Elinor is saddened when Edward writes to say he will not visit. 
Marianne sprains her ankle while visiting the beach with Margaret and is rescued by John Willoughby, to whom she is immediately attracted. They begin courting, but just as the family anticipate a proposal, Willoughby abruptly announces that he must travel to London and will be gone for 12 months.
